title: Stop Departure Payload (v1.0.0)
description: A bus departs a stop. Records boarding/alighting during the dwell and occupancy on departure.

bus_id.description: Vehicle identifier. B-101 to B-107 run in service; B-108 to B-111 are reserve buses.

trip_id.description: Trip identifier on the standard route.

boarded.description: Passengers who boarded at this stop.

alighted.description: Passengers who alighted at this stop.

rejected.description: Passengers left behind because the bus was full.

occupancy.description: Occupancy on departure. Bus capacity is 40.
